_comment: Expansion 3 part F.4: Animate Dead and Create Undead (road op 'raise'; F.5: Planar Ally and Planar Binding, road op 'bind', game/servants.py: servants kept on their master). Part F.1: allies on the field - Find Familiar and Find Steed (docs/expansions/03-demigods-magics.md), numbers from the 2024 Player's Handbook. Done in game/allies.py (road ops 'familiar' and 'steed'); in a fight the 'ally' op calls Battle.add_ally. The steed's three once-a-day gifts are spells of the steed alone (classes 'creature': no scroll, no spellbook).

find_familiar.name: Find Familiar

material.text: burning incense worth 10+ GP, which the spell consumes

find_familiar.text: A spirit serves you as a small beast (bat, cat, owl, raven...), celestial, fey or fiend at heart. It goes where you go, keeps watch at night and Helps in every fight, but cannot attack. At 0 hit points it is gone until cast again; it can be sent away and called back.

find_steed.name: Find Steed
find_steed.text: A steed from another world (a horse, camel or dire wolf to look at; celestial, fey or fiend) fights beside you and carries you on the road: AC 10 + level, 5 + 10 hit points a level, a slam of 1d8 + level. It vanishes at 0 hit points or when you die.

steed_fell_glare.name: Fell Glare
steed_fell_glare.text: A fiendish steed's glare (once a long rest): a creature it sees within 60 feet makes a Wisdom save or is Frightened for a round.

steed_fey_step.name: Fey Step
steed_fey_step.text: A fey steed steps through the world to a free place up to 60 feet away (once a long rest).

steed_healing_touch.name: Healing Touch
steed_healing_touch.text: A celestial steed's touch heals a friend beside it 2d8 and the spell's level (once a long rest).

animate_dead.name: Animate Dead
animate_dead.text: A corpse of the last fight rises as a zombie, or bones as a skeleton (two more a slot above 3), to serve you a day; or it holds four of your dead another day (two more a slot above 3). In a fight they act when you command them (a Bonus Action, 60 feet), else Dodge. Unheld, they turn on you.

create_undead.name: Create Undead

material.text: a black onyx stone worth 150+ GP for each corpse

create_undead.text: At night: three corpses rise as ghouls to serve you a day (four at slot 7; five ghouls or two ghasts or wights at 8; six ghouls, three ghasts or wights or two mummies at 9), or it holds as many another day. Commanded with a Bonus Action (120 feet); unheld, they turn on you.

planar_ally.name: Planar Ally
planar_ally.text: Your god sends a spirit of its kind (a celestial, an elemental or a fiend, at the slot's level) to fight beside you for a price: an hour 1,000 GP, a day 10,000, three days 30,000, ten days 100,000; half if you belong to its church. It acts on its own and goes home when its time is up.

planar_binding.name: Planar Binding

material.text: a jewel worth 1,000+ GP, which the spell consumes

planar_binding.text: A celestial, elemental, fey or fiend you hold (a captive, or a Planar Ally's spirit held in a Magic Circle turned inward) makes a Charisma save or serves you for 24 hours (10, 30, 180 or 366 days with a slot of 6 to 9).
